bugs.error_message: UnsatisfiedDependencyException: Failed to instantiate PushService — Index 0 out of bounds for length 0
bugs.root_cause: @ConditionalOnProperty matches when property value is empty string "". application.yml sets vapid.public-key=${VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY:} which defaults to "", so the condition is always true. PushService tries to Base64-decode empty key → ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
bugs.fix: Replaced @ConditionalOnProperty(name="vapid.public-key") with @ConditionalOnExpression("T(org.springframework.util.StringUtils).hasText('${vapid.public-key:}')") — only creates PushService bean when key is actually non-blank.

bugs.error_message: Login succeeds but no redirect — user stays on login page, no error shown
bugs.root_cause: decodeToken() used atob() directly on JWT payload. JWT uses Base64URL encoding (- and _ chars), but atob() requires standard Base64 (+ and /). atob() throws → catch returns null → login page checks 'if (payload)' which is false → router.push never called.
bugs.fix: Convert Base64URL to Base64 before atob(): replace - with + and _ with /, then add = padding to make length a multiple of 4.

bugs.error_message: Login succeeds (200) but no redirect — stays on login page
bugs.root_cause: generateToken() never added 'role' claim to the JWT. Payload only had sub/iat/exp. Frontend decodeToken() read payload.role = undefined → getDashboardPath() returned /${locale}/login → router.push sent user back to login.
bugs.fix: Added claims.put("role", user.getRole().name()) using pattern matching instanceof to cast UserDetails to User before building the JWT.
